description:
A very popular multi use trail, primarily used for mountain biking. Other activities include E-biking, hiking and trail running. Typically done East to West as a singletrack, downhill ride ranked as a blue. Dog friendly trail.

Distance 1.2 km | Ascent 33m | Descent -62m
directions:
For access, this trail is part of the Mosquito Lake trail systems:

Econoline can be accessed several ways. If riding up Wild Potato, continue up Rock n' Roll to the junction with Ecoconline. This way is a beautiful climb and gives you all of the downhill portion of Econoline.

If approaching from Mosquito Lake, ride up Old Foch Rd, turning right at the sign post and climbing up to the start of Econoline at its eastern terminus.
title: Econoline Trail
